title: Ctrl+Alt+Left/Right moves terminal focus in every view: eagle view, zoomed or not
summary: Ctrl+Alt+Left/Right now moves terminal focus in eagle view, zoomed or not, across every project's terminals in tile order, as well as in project view.
lessons_learned: The issue's Seam named only the two keyboard hooks, but the cross-project tile order lives in TerminalGrid.tsx and MultiProjectView.tsx, so it collided with the Ctrl+T story's seam in the same batch; a Seam for eagle-view keys should name those files.
